cohort.confound: Head positives are MRI only, abdomen mostly CT, chest X-Ray only; cross-modality accuracy cannot isolate region from modality. Both region and modality subgroup reporting required.
cohort.label_source: Original unique SLAKE location metadata and pre-inference visual review
cohort.natural_qa: One original random QA per image, no text-content filter

public_review.limits: Several retained images include upper chest, arms, hips or neck/chin borders. Some generations are not fully clothed despite the prompt. Labels assert abdominal region presence only; not medically realistic or pure abdominal semantics.
public_review.positive_definition: Visible abdominal waist/torso appearance, covered or exposed; not an exclusive abdominal crop and not a clinical label
public_review.prompt_family_amendment: The immutable 48-image generator has only eight unique prompts per style, repeated with different seeds (00/08 etc.). Before any victim scoring, group by actual prompt family, assign families 0-3 fit and 4-7 dev. Preserve all original files and metadata. Minimum amended to four distinct prompt families per split; no additional generation.
public_review.reviewer: Assistant inspection of all 48 generated images in the two contact sheets, before victim feature or target gradient calculation

scope: New image-ID isolated natural-QA pilot; modality confounded, patient independence unknown
